definitions.exclusion_source: Explicit CLI-supplied IDs; this script does not verify membership in attn_case.pdf. See README.md for confirmation/provisional status.
definitions.map_quality: JSON and schema both valid; rank pooled mentioned-category F1 descending, no arbitrary F1 cutoff
definitions.mentions: original GT mention flags and category-presence metrics, not LLM mentioned flags
definitions.route_complexity: GT n_turns>=2 AND distinct MP3D GT region instances n_rooms>=2; not an instruction-semantic assertion
definitions.turn_feature: dense GT direction cosine<0.8, consecutive triggers merged; original episode_features.py
definitions.length: 8<=ours high_level_steps<=15; not low-level steps or trajectory coordinate count
definitions.ranking: mentioned pooled F1, GT turns, GT rooms, closeness to10 high-level steps, then episode ID
definitions.metric_units: SR and SPL fractions; NE metres; source low-level and high-level step counts kept separately
